message.content:
Here’s a quick mix of classic chills and modern scares:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological masterpiece with iconic imagery and an unforgettable score. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A contemporary dread‑filled family drama that turns into pure terror. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Sharp social satire wrapped in a suspenseful thriller. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silent tension and inventive creature design keep you on edge. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Daylight horror that subverts expectations with unsettling folk rituals. |
| 6 | **It Follows** (2014) | An original premise where the threat is always just behind you. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological horror that uses a monster as a metaphor for grief. |
| 8 | **Suspiria** (1977) | Visually striking and musically haunting – a cult classic. |
| 9 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Paranormal investigations grounded in creepy atmosphere. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Found‑footage realism that makes the supernatural feel immediate. |

Feel free to pick based on whether you want a slow burn or instant jump‑scares!
